sermons.title: Sermon 124 | The Snare of the Fowler

scripture.verse: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler.
And the word of the Lord came unto me, saying, Son of man, What is the vine-tree more than any tree, or than a branch which is among the trees of the forest?
Being justified freely by his grace, through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.
And you hath he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins.

sermons.title: Sermon 128 | The Uses of the Law

scripture.verse: Let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.
Except a man be born again, he can not see the kingdom of God.

sermons.title: Sermon 132 | Christ—The Power and Wisdom of God

scripture.verse: Christ the power of God, and the wisdom of God.
